items.stem: A market with a single dominant supplier and high barriers to entry is a:

options.rationale: Perfect competition has many suppliers and no barriers.
Correct: a monopoly has one dominant supplier and high entry barriers.
An oligopoly has a few dominant suppliers, not one.
A monopsony is a market with a single dominant buyer, not seller.

items.explanation: Correct: a monopoly has one dominant supplier and high entry barriers.

items.stem: Which analysis tool scans political, economic, social, technological, legal and environmental factors?

options.rationale: Correct: PESTLE scans these macro-environmental factors.
Kraljic positions purchases by risk and value.
Five forces analyses competitive forces within an industry, not the macro-environment.

items.stem: Which TWO practices keep a tender evaluation fair and defensible?

options.text: Setting and publishing weighted criteria before bids open
options.rationale: Correct: fixed, pre-published criteria ensure fairness.

options.text: Scoring all bids against the same criteria
options.rationale: Correct: consistent scoring is essential to a defensible award.

options.text: Adjusting the weightings to favour a preferred bidder
options.rationale: Changing weightings to favour a bidder is improper and indefensible.

options.text: Discarding the audit trail after award
options.rationale: An audit trail must be retained to justify the decision.

items.explanation: Correct: fixed, pre-published criteria ensure fairness.
